sourceOfTruth.rule: EF migration runs only after build succeeds. The client DbContext and generated migration output are authoritative for schema changes.

whenToRun: For Core 8.x and major version upgrades unless the version entry explicitly says no EF migration is required.

commands.default: dotnet ef migrations add UpgradeCore{major}x --context NgoContext --project <migrations-project>

retryRules.action: Search for the concrete DbContext and rerun with fully qualified --context.
Return to the build-fix loop before retrying migration.

retryRules.whenOutputContains: No migrations configuration type was found
retryRules.action: Retry with fully qualified context name.

antiPatterns: Do not run EF migration before build succeeds.
Do not manually edit the model snapshot without EF output evidence.
Do not treat no changes detected as failure.

commands: dotnet ef migrations add UpgradeCore{major}x --context NgoContext --project <migrations-project>
successCriteria: Migration command exits successfully or reports no changes detected.
Generated migration and snapshot changes are included in the final report when present.
